reading_note: The teaching uses the image of a person bending over water and seeing his reflected face — head appearing downward, feet above — as a sustained correspondence for how heavenly realities present themselves in the natural mind. The single arc moves through three linked mysteries: (1) the Call — divine truth cast downward from the Lord into the natural/external realm, which appears there as an inverted image; (2) the Answer — the awakened response that ascends from below to above, like a face seen rising back out of the water; (3) the begetting and shadow — every spiritual reality, in being born into ultimates, casts a natural correspondent ("shadow") upon the earth, and this very shadow is the sign that the spiritual body has risen up out of the merely natural Deep. Stars, zodiac, trees, cattle reflected in the great sea = the whole order of spiritual states mirrored in the natural mind through correspondence. The teaching is essentially a doctrine of correspondence itself: the natural is the inverted image of the spiritual, and to see the heavenly face in the water is to read the world spiritually.
